Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?

No — once an order is placed, it can’t be canceled, and there isn’t a cancellation window. Orders move into processing right away, so we’re not able to stop or modify them after checkout.

turns.q: Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
turns.replyTail:
Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?

No — once an order is placed, it can’t be canceled, and there isn’t a cancellation window. Orders move into processing right away, so we’re not able to stop or modify them after checkout.

Can I add an item to an order I already placed?

No — items can’t be added to an order after it’s been placed. Orders move into processing right away, so the best option is to place a separate order for the additional item.
